name: github-broker
description: Run the host's gh login for the jail against this workspace's GitHub repositories, its remotes and any its config lists under brokered.github.repos, as approved at launch, and only under a read grant in config (brokered.github.grants; with none, every call is refused): reads run, writes require exact host Allow-once approval and a one-use grant, and every call is audited on the host (yolo audit).
